Name: Rayne's Portraits
Author: RaynneDrop
Description:
A portraiture pack handdrawn by me! 

[u][b]What's included?[/b][/u]

you can decide between two different packs - the full version, with all the different variations, or a LITE version, with just the base designs! 

So far, I am done with Sebastian, Sam, Shane and Alex. There are some slight variations you get to pick from! 

The portrait sizes are 512x512.

[u]Sebastian :[/u]
         - Regular hairstyle
         - short hair
         - mullet
+ A secondary beach portrait without the t-shirt. If you'd prefer to use this one, simply delete the one with the t-shirt and rename the shirtless one to "Sebastian_IslandSouth.png"

[u]Sam :[/u]
         - regular hair 
         - regular hair + piercings 
         - undercut
         - undercut + piercings 

[u]Shane :
[/u]        - regular version
        - shaved version
        - soft version ( softens his features slightly ) 

[u]Alex :[/u]
        - regular version

[u][b]How to install?[/b]

FULL VERSION 

[/u]1. Download Portraiture.
2. Drag and drop Portraiture into your mods folder.
3. Locate the "Portraits" folder in portraiture.
4. Download and unzip my mod and pick your favorite version for each character and copy and paste it into the folder. 
5. As soon as you are in-game, talk to one of the characters that is already included in the mod and press "P" to enable it! DONE!

[u]LITE VERSION
[/u]
Same as above but instead of having to pick from a variety of designs, simply drag and drop the unzipped folder into your portraits folder and you're good to go!

[b][u]What's planned for the future?

[/u][/b]I mean, ideally, I'd like to do all the villagers at some point, maybe even do seasonal variations for PortraiturePlus. For now, I want to finish up the bachelors and bachelorettes! This might take some time though. I think I'd prefer to maybe do SVE and RSV before I do seasonal variations? Let me know what you think! 

[b][u]THANK YOU VERY MUCH FOR DOWNLOADING! ♡

[/u][/b]If you have any questions, feedback or suggestions, please don't hesitate to let me know! Just please stay respectful, okay? ♡

If you want to make extra outfits for any of the characters, feel free to do so! Just please credit me. For anything else - like alterations -, please contact me first! But absolutely DO NOT USE my drawings for AI machine learning!
